It first aired in Japan on September 27, 2007, as part of a one-hour special alongside DP047. (Japanese: サトシとヒカリ！新たなる冒険に向かって！！ and ! Facing a New Adventure!!) is the 48th episode of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, and the 514th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on September 27, 2007, as part of a one-hour special alongside DP047. In the vein of AG120, this episode is a clip show that summarizes the first year of the Diamond & Pearl saga.

==Trivia==
Aim to Be a Pokémon Master 2001, instrumental versions of By Your Side ~Hikari's Theme~ and Advance Adventure, and Pokémon Symphonic Medley are used as background music.
This is the second clip episode in the Pokémon animated series's history, the first being AG120. Like its predecessor, it was skipped in the dub. This was also the first episode to be skipped by The Pokémon Company International.
Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia: 
Pokémon senryū: ドダイトス　こうらはみどりの　どだいです Dodaitosu, kōra wa midori no, dodai desu.
Jessie's Wobbuffet doesn't appear in this episode.
As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan.
